gloom.en: A sense of gloom disappeared when the team finally solved the problem.
gloom.zh: 當團隊終於解決問題時，低落的氣氛消散了。

gloomy.en: The morning looked gloomy, but the sky cleared before lunch.
gloomy.zh: 早晨看起來陰沉，但中午前天空就放晴了。

glorious.en: We enjoyed a glorious sunset after reaching the top of the hill.
glorious.zh: 我們登上山頂後欣賞到壯麗的夕陽。

glory.en: The athlete cared more about teamwork than personal glory after the match.
glory.zh: 比賽後，那位運動員更重視團隊合作，而不是個人榮耀。

glow.en: The lamps began to glow softly as evening settled over the park.
glow.zh: 傍晚降臨公園時，燈光開始柔和地發亮。

glue.en: Use a small amount of glue to attach the paper to the board.
glue.zh: 用少量膠水把紙黏到板子上。

goalkeeper.en: The goalkeeper caught the ball before it crossed the goal line.
goalkeeper.zh: 守門員在球越過球門線前把球接住了。

goat.en: A young goat climbed onto a rock beside the farm fence.
goat.zh: 一隻小山羊爬上農場圍欄旁的岩石。

goddess.en: The museum displayed an ancient statue of a goddess from local mythology.
goddess.zh: 博物館展出一尊來自當地神話的古代女神雕像。

golden.en: The field turned golden under the warm light of the setting sun.
golden.zh: 田野在夕陽溫暖的光線下變成金黃色。

golf.en: She learned the basic rules of golf during a school sports camp.
golf.zh: 她在學校運動營學會了高爾夫球的基本規則。

goodbye.en: We said goodbye to our exchange students after the final class.
goodbye.zh: 最後一堂課後，我們向交換學生道別。

goods.en: The market sells locally made goods to visitors throughout the year.
goods.zh: 這個市場全年向遊客販售當地製作的商品。

goodwill.en: The project created goodwill between the school and the surrounding community.
goodwill.zh: 這項計畫促進了學校與周邊社區之間的善意。

goose.en: A goose stood near the pond while its young followed closely behind.
goose.zh: 一隻鵝站在池塘旁，幼鵝緊跟在後面。

gorgeous.en: The photographer captured a gorgeous view of the mountains after the rain.
gorgeous.zh: 攝影師拍下雨後山區的美麗景色。

gorilla.en: The documentary followed a gorilla family living in a protected forest.
gorilla.zh: 這部紀錄片跟拍一個生活在保護森林中的大猩猩家庭。

gospel.en: The class discussed how gospel music influenced several modern musical styles.
gospel.zh: 課堂討論福音音樂如何影響多種現代音樂風格。

gossip.en: Spreading gossip can damage trust even when the story seems harmless.
gossip.zh: 散播八卦即使看似無害，也可能破壞信任。

govern.en: Clear laws help govern how public institutions make important decisions.
govern.zh: 清楚的法律有助於規範公共機構如何做重要決策。

governor.en: The governor visited the region to discuss transportation and education plans.
governor.zh: 州長造訪該地區，討論交通與教育計畫。

gown.en: The graduate adjusted her gown before walking onto the stage.
gown.zh: 畢業生走上舞台前整理好自己的畢業袍。

grab.en: He had to grab the railing when the bus stopped suddenly.
grab.zh: 公車突然停下時，他不得不抓住扶手。

grace.en: The dancer moved across the stage with impressive grace and control.
grace.zh: 舞者以令人印象深刻的優雅與控制力在舞台上移動。

graceful.en: The swan made a graceful turn as it moved across the lake.
graceful.zh: 天鵝在湖面前進時優雅地轉了個彎。

gracious.en: Our host was gracious and made every visitor feel welcome.
gracious.zh: 主人十分親切有禮，讓每位訪客都感到受歡迎。

graduation.en: The school held its graduation ceremony in the auditorium on Friday.
graduation.zh: 學校星期五在禮堂舉行畢業典禮。

gram.en: The science activity required exactly one gram of salt for each sample.
gram.zh: 這項科學活動每個樣本都需要正好一公克的鹽。

grammatical.en: The teacher explained why the sentence was grammatical but still sounded unnatural.
grammatical.zh: 老師解釋那個句子為何文法正確，卻仍聽起來不自然。

grand.en: The old theater has a grand entrance with tall stone columns.
grand.zh: 那座老劇院有一個帶著高大石柱的宏偉入口。

grape.en: She placed a grape beside each cheese cube on the plate.
grape.zh: 她在盤中每塊起司旁放了一顆葡萄。

grapefruit.en: A grapefruit has a stronger bitter taste than many other citrus fruits.
grapefruit.zh: 葡萄柚比許多其他柑橘類水果有更明顯的苦味。

graph.en: The graph shows how average temperature changed over the past decade.
graph.zh: 這張圖表顯示過去十年平均溫度如何變化。

graphic.en: The report includes a graphic that summarizes the survey results clearly.
graphic.zh: 報告包含一張清楚整理調查結果的圖像。

grasp.en: A strong grasp of basic algebra makes later lessons much easier.
grasp.zh: 扎實掌握基礎代數會讓之後的課程容易許多。

grasshopper.en: A grasshopper jumped from the path into the tall grass nearby.
grasshopper.zh: 一隻蚱蜢從小徑跳進附近的高草叢。

grassy.en: The students sat on a grassy slope during the outdoor lesson.
grassy.zh: 學生在戶外課程中坐在一個長滿草的斜坡上。

grateful.en: I am grateful for the classmates who helped me finish the project.
grateful.zh: 我很感激幫助我完成專題的同學。

gratitude.en: She expressed gratitude to the volunteers who organized the community event.
gratitude.zh: 她向籌辦社區活動的志工表達感謝。

grave.en: The report described the water shortage as a grave environmental concern.
grave.zh: 報告把缺水形容為嚴重的環境問題。

gravity.en: The experiment demonstrates how gravity pulls objects toward the ground.
gravity.zh: 這項實驗示範重力如何把物體拉向地面。

gray.en: Dark clouds turned the afternoon sky a deep gray before the storm.
gray.zh: 暴風雨前，烏雲把午後天空染成深灰色。

graze.en: Several sheep graze quietly in the field behind the farmhouse.
graze.zh: 幾隻羊安靜地在農舍後方的田地吃草。

grease.en: The mechanic wiped grease from the metal surface before checking it.
grease.zh: 技師檢查前先擦掉金屬表面的油脂。

greasy.en: The paper became greasy after it touched the fried food.
greasy.zh: 那張紙碰到油炸食物後變得油膩。

greed.en: The novel shows how greed can damage friendships and family relationships.
greed.zh: 這本小說呈現貪婪如何破壞友情與家庭關係。

greedy.en: The story warns that a greedy character may lose what matters most.
greedy.zh: 故事提醒人們，貪心的角色可能失去最重要的事物。

greenhouse.en: The school greenhouse allows students to grow vegetables during cooler months.
greenhouse.zh: 學校溫室讓學生能在較冷的月份種植蔬菜。

greeting.en: Her warm greeting helped the new student feel less nervous.
greeting.zh: 她溫暖的問候讓新同學感到沒那麼緊張。

grief.en: The novel explores how a family learns to live with grief.
grief.zh: 這本小說探討一個家庭如何學著面對悲傷。

grieve.en: People may grieve in different ways after losing someone important.
grieve.zh: 失去重要的人之後，每個人可能用不同方式哀傷。

grill.en: We used the outdoor grill to cook vegetables during the picnic.
grill.zh: 野餐時，我們用戶外烤架烤蔬菜。

grim.en: The forecast looked grim, but the storm changed direction overnight.
grim.zh: 預報看起來不樂觀，但暴風雨一夜之間改變了方向。

grin.en: A wide grin appeared on his face when the results were announced.
grin.zh: 結果公布時，他臉上露出大大的笑容。

grind.en: The machine can grind roasted beans into a fine powder quickly.
grind.zh: 這台機器可以快速把烘焙豆磨成細粉。

grip.en: She tightened her grip on the umbrella as the wind grew stronger.
grip.zh: 風變強時，她把雨傘握得更緊。

groan.en: The old door gave a soft groan when it slowly opened.
groan.zh: 那扇老門慢慢打開時發出低沉的嘎吱聲。

grocery.en: The grocery store added a section for locally grown vegetables.
grocery.zh: 這家雜貨店新增了一區販售在地種植的蔬菜。

groom.en: The groom thanked the guests before the celebration began.
groom.zh: 慶祝活動開始前，新郎向賓客致謝。

gross.en: The company reported its gross income before subtracting operating costs.
gross.zh: 公司先公布總收入，再扣除營運成本。

growl.en: We heard a low growl from the dog behind the fence.
growl.zh: 我們聽到圍欄後的狗發出低沉吼聲。

grumble.en: Some students grumble about homework but still complete it on time.
grumble.zh: 有些學生會抱怨作業，但仍會準時完成。

guard.en: A security guard stood near the entrance during the evening event.
guard.zh: 晚間活動期間，一名警衛站在入口附近。

guardian.en: A parent or guardian must sign the permission form before Friday.
guardian.zh: 家長或監護人必須在星期五前簽署同意書。

guava.en: The fruit stand sells fresh guava along with bananas and oranges.
guava.zh: 水果攤販售新鮮芭樂，也有香蕉和柳橙。

guidance.en: The counselor offered guidance about choosing subjects for next semester.
guidance.zh: 輔導老師提供下學期選課方面的建議。

guideline.en: Each guideline explains one rule for writing the research report.
guideline.zh: 每一項指引都說明撰寫研究報告的一條規則。

guilt.en: He felt guilt after realizing his careless comment had hurt a friend.
guilt.zh: 他發現自己無心的話傷害朋友後感到內疚。

guitar.en: She practices guitar for thirty minutes after finishing her homework.
guitar.zh: 她寫完作業後會練三十分鐘吉他。

gulf.en: The discussion revealed a wide gulf between the two proposed solutions.
gulf.zh: 討論顯示兩個提案之間有很大的差距。

gull.en: A gull circled above the harbor before landing near the pier.
gull.zh: 一隻海鷗在港口上空盤旋後降落在碼頭附近。

gum.en: Please throw your gum away before entering the science laboratory.
gum.zh: 進入科學實驗室前請把口香糖丟掉。

gut.en: The article explains how the gut contains many kinds of helpful bacteria.
gut.zh: 文章說明腸道中含有許多種類的有益細菌。

guy.en: The guy at the information desk showed us where to go.
guy.zh: 服務台的那位先生告訴我們該往哪裡走。

gym.en: The basketball team practices in the gym every Tuesday afternoon.
gym.zh: 籃球隊每週二下午都在體育館練習。

gymnasium.en: The school gymnasium can hold several hundred people during large events.
gymnasium.zh: 學校體育館在大型活動時可容納數百人。

hardware.en: The computer club upgraded its hardware before starting the new project.
hardware.zh: 電腦社在開始新專題前升級了硬體設備。

harmonica.en: He learned a simple song on the harmonica during music class.
harmonica.zh: 他在音樂課用口琴學會了一首簡單的曲子。

harmony.en: The choir practiced until every voice blended together in harmony.
harmony.zh: 合唱團持續練習，直到每個聲部和諧融合。

harness.en: Engineers hope to harness wind power more efficiently in coastal areas.
harness.zh: 工程師希望在沿海地區更有效率地利用風力。

harsh.en: The harsh winter damaged several young trees in the school garden.
harsh.zh: 嚴酷的冬天傷害了學校花園裡幾棵幼樹。

harvest.en: Farmers began the rice harvest after several weeks of dry weather.
harvest.zh: 連續幾週乾燥天氣後，農民開始收割稻米。

haste.en: In his haste, he forgot to check the final page of the test.
haste.zh: 他因為匆忙，忘了檢查考卷最後一頁。

hasten.en: Warmer temperatures can hasten the melting of mountain snow in spring.
hasten.zh: 較高的溫度可能加速春季山區積雪融化。

hasty.en: A hasty decision may create more problems than it solves.
hasty.zh: 匆促的決定可能製造比解決更多的問題。

hatch.en: The eggs usually hatch after several weeks in a warm nest.
hatch.zh: 這些蛋通常會在溫暖巢中數週後孵化。

hateful.en: The teacher reminded everyone that hateful language can seriously harm others.
hateful.zh: 老師提醒大家，充滿仇恨的言語可能嚴重傷害他人。

hatred.en: The novel shows how hatred can divide communities for many years.
hatred.zh: 這本小說呈現仇恨如何讓社群分裂多年。

haul.en: Workers used a cart to haul boxes across the large warehouse.
haul.zh: 工作人員用推車把箱子運過大型倉庫。

haunt.en: Memories of the difficult season continued to haunt the team for months.
haunt.zh: 那段艱難賽季的記憶持續困擾團隊好幾個月。

hawk.en: A hawk circled high above the field while we watched quietly.
hawk.zh: 我們安靜觀看時，一隻鷹在田野上空盤旋。

hay.en: The farmer stored dry hay in the barn before the rainy season.
hay.zh: 農夫在雨季前把乾草存放在穀倉裡。

hazard.en: Loose cables on the floor can become a safety hazard in classrooms.
hazard.zh: 地板上鬆散的電線可能成為教室中的安全危險。

headache.en: After reading for hours, he developed a mild headache and took a break.
headache.zh: 讀了幾個小時後，他有點頭痛，便休息了一下。

headphone.en: One headphone stopped working during the listening practice in class.
headphone.zh: 課堂聽力練習時，其中一邊耳機突然不能用了。

headquarters.en: The organization moved its headquarters to a larger office near the station.
headquarters.zh: 該組織把總部搬到車站附近一間更大的辦公室。

heal.en: Small cuts usually heal over time when they are kept clean.
heal.zh: 小傷口保持清潔時，通常會隨時間癒合。

healthful.en: The cafeteria added several healthful choices such as fruit and whole grains.
healthful.zh: 餐廳增加了水果與全穀物等健康選擇。

heap.en: A heap of fallen leaves collected beside the garden wall.
heap.zh: 一堆落葉聚集在花園牆邊。

hearty.en: We ate a hearty breakfast before beginning the long morning hike.
hearty.zh: 開始漫長的上午健行前，我們吃了一頓豐盛早餐。

heater.en: The classroom heater was turned on before students arrived that morning.
heater.zh: 那天早上學生到校前，教室暖氣就先開啟了。

heaven.en: The poem uses heaven as a symbol of peace and hope.
heaven.zh: 這首詩以天堂象徵和平與希望。

hedge.en: A tall hedge separates the school garden from the parking area.
hedge.zh: 一排高樹籬把學校花園和停車區隔開。

heel.en: The back of the shoe rubbed against his heel during the walk.
heel.zh: 走路時，鞋子後方摩擦到他的腳跟。

heighten.en: Bright lighting can heighten the contrast between colors in a photograph.
heighten.zh: 明亮的光線可以提高照片中顏色之間的對比。

heir.en: The novel follows an heir who must decide how to manage the family estate.
heir.zh: 這本小說描述一位繼承人如何決定管理家族產業。

helicopter.en: A rescue helicopter flew over the valley during the training exercise.
helicopter.zh: 救援直升機在訓練演習期間飛越山谷。

hello.en: She smiled and said hello to the new student beside her.
hello.zh: 她微笑著向身旁的新同學說哈囉。

helmet.en: The cyclist checked that his helmet was secure before the race.
helmet.zh: 自行車手在比賽前確認安全帽已戴牢。

hemisphere.en: Winter begins at different times in each hemisphere because of Earth's tilt.
hemisphere.zh: 因為地球傾斜，兩個半球的冬季開始時間不同。

hen.en: A hen led several chicks across the yard toward their shelter.
hen.zh: 一隻母雞帶著幾隻小雞穿過院子走向棚舍。

hence.en: The road was flooded, hence the school bus took another route.
hence.zh: 道路淹水，因此校車改走另一條路線。

herb.en: The cooking class used a fresh herb to add flavor to the soup.
herb.zh: 烹飪課用新鮮香草替湯增添風味。

herd.en: A herd of deer crossed the field just before sunset.
herd.zh: 日落前，一群鹿穿過田野。

heritage.en: The festival celebrates the town's cultural heritage through music and food.
heritage.zh: 這個節慶透過音樂與食物慶祝城鎮的文化傳承。

hero.en: The novel's hero solves the mystery by carefully examining small clues.
hero.zh: 小說中的主角透過仔細觀察小線索解開謎團。

heroic.en: The article described the firefighters' rescue effort as truly heroic.
heroic.zh: 文章把消防員的救援行動形容為真正英勇。

heroine.en: The heroine of the story becomes more confident as the journey continues.
heroine.zh: 故事中的女主角隨著旅程進行變得更有自信。

hers.en: The blue notebook on the desk is hers, not mine.
hers.zh: 桌上的藍色筆記本是她的，不是我的。

herself.en: She taught herself basic coding by following several beginner lessons online.
herself.zh: 她透過幾堂線上入門課自學基礎程式設計。

hesitation.en: After a brief hesitation, he raised his hand and answered the question.
hesitation.zh: 短暫猶豫後，他舉手回答了問題。

hide.en: Thick clouds can hide the mountain peaks from view in winter.
hide.zh: 冬天厚重的雲層可能遮住山峰。

highway.en: The new highway reduced travel time between the two towns significantly.
highway.zh: 新公路大幅縮短了兩座城鎮之間的旅行時間。

hike.en: Our class planned a short hike along the forest trail on Saturday.
hike.zh: 我們班計畫星期六沿著森林步道健行一小段。

himself.en: He built the small model himself after studying the instructions carefully.
himself.zh: 他仔細研究說明後，自己完成了這個小模型。

hint.en: The teacher gave us a hint without revealing the final answer.
hint.zh: 老師給了我們一個提示，但沒有透露最後答案。

hip.en: The diagram shows how the hip connects the upper leg to the body.
hip.zh: 圖示說明髖部如何連接大腿與身體。

hippo.en: The zoo's hippo spent most of the afternoon resting in the water.
hippo.zh: 動物園的河馬下午大部分時間都在水中休息。

hippopotamus.en: A hippopotamus can spend many hours in water during hot weather.
hippopotamus.zh: 天氣炎熱時，河馬可以在水中待上好幾個小時。

hire.en: The company plans to hire more interns for the summer research program.
hire.zh: 公司計畫為暑期研究計畫聘用更多實習生。

historian.en: A local historian explained how the railway changed the town's economy.
historian.zh: 一位地方歷史學家解釋鐵路如何改變城鎮經濟。

historic.en: The city is restoring a historic building near the old railway station.
historic.zh: 市政府正在修復舊火車站附近的一棟歷史建築。

hive.en: The beekeeper checked the hive carefully without disturbing the bees.
hive.zh: 養蜂人仔細檢查蜂巢，避免驚擾蜜蜂。

hoarse.en: His voice became hoarse after cheering loudly throughout the game.
hoarse.zh: 他整場比賽大聲加油後，聲音變得沙啞。

hobby.en: Photography became her favorite hobby after she joined the school club.
hobby.zh: 加入學校社團後，攝影成了她最喜歡的興趣。

hockey.en: The students watched a hockey match to learn more about the sport.
hockey.zh: 學生觀看一場冰上曲棍球比賽，以了解這項運動。

holder.en: The ticket holder must show identification before entering the event area.
holder.zh: 持票人進入活動區前必須出示身分證明。

hollow.en: The old tree had a hollow trunk where small animals could shelter.
hollow.zh: 那棵老樹的樹幹中空，小動物可以在裡面躲藏。

holy.en: The temple is considered a holy place by many local residents.
holy.zh: 許多當地居民把這座寺廟視為神聖之地。

homeland.en: The author often wrote about memories of her homeland in later essays.
homeland.zh: 作者在後期文章中常寫到對故鄉的回憶。

homesick.en: He felt homesick during his first week at the summer program.
homesick.zh: 參加暑期課程的第一週，他感到想家。

hometown.en: She returned to her hometown during the holiday to visit relatives.
hometown.zh: 假期期間，她回到家鄉探望親戚。
